summary: MetalFX offers GPU temporal and spatial upscalers plus frame interpolation, all fed by Metal textures and command buffers. BifrOSt has no upscaling scaler: its nearest code is CPU bilinear resampling and a GL_LINEAR blur pyramid on the GLES presenter, neither of which takes motion, depth or colour-space input. Wave 15 (2026-10-19) adds sdk image_scaler: SpatialScaler, TemporalImageScaler and FrameInterpolator over app Images, on the CPU.

features.note: Jittered accumulation with depth rejection and neighbourhood clamping is a pure CPU model with host tests, and it is not wired into apps or the shell. Gap: the presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:147) receives no motion or depth buffers and the scaler has no GPU pass, so it needs the lab machine to verify. Built 2026-10-19: image_scaler::TemporalImageScaler takes Image frames plus depth and motion buffers, decodes sRGB to linear light, accumulates with the render-crate scaler and returns an opaque Image; next_jitter and reset are exposed; sizes and buffer lengths are checked (ScalerError). Still a gap: no GPU pass and no presenter wiring. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (the_first_temporal_frame_is_the_spatial_upscale_of_its_colour, a_static_scene_converges_and_a_reset_forgets_the_history); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

Denoised accumulation runs a 3x3 box filter on the input colour and keeps 95 percent history, all in the CPU model with host tests. Gap: the box filter is not a learned denoiser, and the GPU path has no temporal history buffer, so the lab machine must verify it. Built 2026-10-19: TemporalImageScaler::new(.., denoised = true) selects the 95 percent history mode with the box denoise of the input colour; is_denoised reports it. Still a gap: the denoiser is a box filter, not learned. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (a_static_scene_converges_and_a_reset_forgets_the_history); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

A CPU Catmull-Rom bicubic upscaler with clamped edges is tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-39.rs (flat rasters stay flat, bad sizes and sample counts are refused). Gap: there is no edge-aware scaler, no temporal input and no GPU path, so it is a resampler rather than a spatial upscaler, and it is not wired into apps or the shell. Built 2026-10-19: image_scaler::SpatialScaler::scale takes an Image of the configured input size and returns the output-size Image: bicubic colour weighted by alpha so soft edges do not darken, alpha resampled linearly, sizes capped at 16384. Still a gap: no edge-aware pass and no GPU path. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (a_flat_image_stays_flat_in_every_mode, a_gradient_stays_monotone_when_enlarged, transparent_pixels_stay_transparent_and_edges_do_not_darken); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

Linear, perceptual sRGB and HDR modes are tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-39.rs, including overshoot clamped in linear and kept in HDR. Gap: the mode is passed per call rather than read from a colour-space tag on the raster, and nothing is wired into apps or the shell. Built 2026-10-19: SpatialScaler holds the ColorProcessing mode (Perceptual by default for sRGB Images) with a setter and getter. Still a gap: the mode is a scaler setting, not read from a colour-space tag on the Image, and Hdr output is clamped to 8 bits. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (a_flat_image_stays_flat_in_every_mode); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

Wave 4 (w4-metalfx, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No frame generation anywhere in the shell or the GPU presenter. Built 2026-10-19: image_scaler::FrameInterpolator::interpolate(a, b, motion, t) and intermediate_frames(count) work on Images, blend in linear light, interpolate alpha with the same warp, and refuse bad sizes, buffer lengths and t. Still a gap: no occlusion handling, no depth or UI layer, no GPU pass. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (interpolation_endpoints_are_exact_and_the_middle_blends_in_linear_light, motion_moves_the_content_between_frames); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.feature: Metal command-buffer encoding of scaler passes
features.apple: encode(commandBuffer:) on each effect; MTL4FX* protocols
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_pass.rs (RenderPass, the checked pass model apps describe their passes with); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:147 (Presenter, GLES passes), docs/gpu-first.md
features.note: Metal command buffers and the MTL4FX encode protocols exist only on Apple's GPU drivers, so encoding a scaler into a Metal command buffer cannot exist on an Arch Linux system. The GPU passes that remain are the presenter's GLES render passes (one per present), which stay inside the shell, and apps describe their own passes with the checked RenderPass model.

features.feature: Reduced-resolution GPU work with linear upscale
features.apple: Render at low resolution, upscale to output (MetalFX landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_pass.rs (blur_plan, BlurPlan); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:724 (blur pyramid upscale, GL_LINEAR), docs/gpu-first.md:85 (quarter-size base), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:423 (blur_material); springboard/sdk/src/image_scaler.rs (SpatialScaler)
features.note: The divisor, working size and full-size fallback for a reduced copy are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: the linear upscale runs only inside the shell's presenter, and apps get no scaler. Built 2026-10-19: apps now have a scaler to bring a reduced-resolution render back up (SpatialScaler, TemporalImageScaler). Still a gap: the linear upscale of the shell's blur pyramid stays inside the presenter. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_scaler::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (bad_requests_are_refused); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

gaps: Motion vectors and depth input for temporal scaling: the presenter has no per-pixel motion or depth buffers.
Spatial upscaler on the GPU: only CPU bilinear resampling exists, in springboard/render/src/gfx.rs and springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs.
Frame interpolation (macOS 26 API) and the temporal denoiser: no counterpart.
App-facing scaler API in bifrost_app: none, so apps cannot request GPU upscaling of their own render targets.
Colour-space-aware scaling (linear, perceptual, HDR modes): the bilinear helpers take no colour-space parameter.
